items.title: Is Apple's hardware the key to John Ternus's success as new CEO?
items.summary: It's a brand-new era for Apple (AAPL) as Tim Cook officially hands off the chief executive reins on Tuesday and John Ternus starts his first day as CEO. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian to examine the areas within Apple's products that Ternus may focus on to be just as successful a leader as Cook.

items.title: Rewind to 2011: Tim Cook's first Apple product launch as CEO
items.summary: Tim Cook's first product launch as Apple's (AAPL) CEO on Oct. 4, 2011, featured the unveiling of the iPhone 4s and the debut of Siri.

items.title: Here's what Tim Cook posted on his last day as Apple's CEO
items.summary: Market Domination host Josh Lipton reports on Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook's departing message on X on his last day as the company head, and on the departure of Phil Schiller, who led the App Store and product events.

items.title: Gap Up on Leadership Shift; Shein's Market Debut | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Gap (GAP) shares jumped after naming a retail industry veteran to head Old Navy and profit outpaced estimates, offsetting a sales decline at the value chain and lower sales guidance. - Apple's (AAPL) Tim Cook handed over the reins to John Ternus on Tuesday, capping a tenure as chief executive officer that cemented the company as an iconic global brand and turned its stock into one of the most reliable bets. - Shein Global Holdings' shares long-awaited market debut has come at an awkward time: the fast-fashion retailer's peak growth years are behind it just as tariffs, regulatory pressure and intensifying competition are making its next phase harder.

items.title: What Does Apple (AAPL) Risk From Its Trade Secrets Lawsuit?
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and a former engineer over alleged theft of confidential circuit schematics and related trade secrets. The complaint accuses the former Apple employee of misappropriating proprietary hardware designs and integrating them into OpenAI projects. Apple is seeking damages, a preliminary injunction, and court orders to destroy any materials that allegedly contain its protected technology. The case adds fresh scrutiny to how major AI players...

items.title: Apple Says Ex-Employee Gave Secret Files to OpenAI
items.summary: The Apple OpenAI lawsuit escalates as Apple files new evidence and more than 400 former staff build a secret consumer hardware device.

items.title: Apple and Meta Struggled in August But Which Looks Stronger in September?
items.summary: Apple and Meta both stumbled through August, but their earnings reports reveal two very different companies heading into a September packed with product launches, legal settlements, and AI spending decisions that could swing either stock hard.

items.title: ‘Your Stock Doesn’t Know Your Name’: Wes Moss on Owning Too Much Apple, Google
items.summary: A 45-year-old investor with a million dollars on the line and a third of it riding on three stocks asked Wes Moss how to escape. His answer starts with a mindset shift most investors resist making.
